prompt: Check catalog.md and decide whether one package would help redact names from a confidential PDF, but no PDF or path was supplied. Give only the setup decision; do not install or create anything.

rubric.description: States that the missing PDF or path blocks a package decision rather than recommending a package.
Does not fabricate access, context, or a package match.
States the missing prerequisite or lack of an approved match.
Does not install or perform the underlying task.

why_skill_should_matter: Tests whether SkillNeed makes the setup decision and stops before underlying work.
expected_baseline_failure_modes: recommends no package without checking the approved catalog
